notes.title: Led It Rain patch new mechanics 121224
notes.notes:
Gasoline Daredevils and Adrenaline Addicts

Key 121224 Update Features:

* December Update Launch
* 112 % more James Death.. James Death is dead, or is he?
* New player controller mechanisms (shift to boost this time for real, space to SLIIIIIDDDDEEEE).
* Cocktail minigame on victory lap.
* New score system after laps. The Awesome High Level score Board.
* Monsters now attack player bike. Full panic mode can be avoided by pressing F
* Monsters start to dance when near player cos they do not feel threatened.
* Graphical adjustments.. 0.03 % less bloom. 
* Additional Quality-of-Life Updates

* Coming soon on near death: Ultimate Evil BOSS Encounter 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25239449/5523a5069b6d07e5714d21729c3e91f95a236201.png

Nicole says: Stay tuned for more details on the December update with the upcoming Release Notes and updates. In the meantime, we’ll see you in Amorica!

There is upcoming videos and advertisement because THE GAME feels really solid and good.

notes.title: Returna patch
notes.notes:
Returna update and patch

After some tests with the player engine we go back to trusted clicker type aim system that the game is build on.

-Amplified graphics with universal Post Process profile.

notes.title: Led It Rain 1.1 Release
notes.notes:
12.12.19 Led It Rain Remastered 1.1. 

Full patch notes later - many changes. Full game mechanics overhaul. Shooting and driving changed. Bugfixes. Solid gameplay and final gamelogic for first part. Enjoy!!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25239449/35cedb847bec6293f028181099f12e300aa1ad59.png

Led It Rain is first person shooter motorcycle driving racing game. with 12 years of history. And is inspired by 90s films and arcade games. Motorcycles, guns, monsters and bikini-babes. Faster you drive and shoot monsters more score you obtain. Each race track has three laps of horror and adrenaline. Enjoy!!
